name: michibiki
description: Michibiki is a CLI-first AI video production router for VideoSpec generation and engine selection.
author: Takamasa Ito

scripts.build: tsc -b packages/video-spec packages/router packages/compliance packages/render-jobs packages/browser-renderer packages/engine-remotion packages/engine-hyperframes packages/engine-editframe apps/cli
scripts.release:check: pnpm build && pnpm test && pnpm audit --audit-level moderate && pnpm pack:check
